note: Wooded campground on the ridge northeast of Lake Geode; the tent-only sites run down a spur toward the lake. No daily park-entry fee in Iowa. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 20/30/50A, full hookups at 12 sites, showers, dump, 100% reservable. Sites corrected 167 -> 81 (63 RV + 18 tent; 40-85 ft, pull-throughs). Season conflict DNR (Apr 1-Dec 14) vs RA (Mar 15-Nov 30) recorded. Not waterfront confirmed. Pin fine (~150 m).
flags: SITES: stored count 167 (from note prose: '~86 electric, ~81 non-electric') is not supported. ReserveAmerica lists 81 sites in Geode Campground (51 Standard Electric, 12 Standard Full Hook-Up, 18 Tent Only) plus youth group site Y and 'Campground Host 24'. There are no non-electric RV sites; every RV site is 40-85 ft, so all 63 fit a 23-ft motorhome.

SEASON (two official pages disagree): DNR park page 'accepts reservations April 1 - December 14 and is closed December 15 - March 31'; ReserveAmerica 'closed each year from December 1 - March 14', reservations 'March 15 - November 30'. DNR dates kept in the fields, both in season.note.
PARTIAL CLOSURE: DNR alert (posted 8/14/2026) 'Camspites 11-13 and 27-29 are closed September 20, 2026-May 31, 2027 due to repaving'. Recorded in sites.note, not a status.

WATERFRONT (not waterfront confirmed): all 82 RA sites tagged 'Near Water - no'. On NAIP the RV loops sit under canopy on the ridge 300+ m from Lake Geode; only the tent-only spur (sites 70-84) runs toward the lake and it stays in woods. The small ponds east of the campground are under 5 acres (one is a pair of treatment cells).
PIN fine: RA site points centre on 40.82365,-91.38265, ~150 m from the stored pin.
